title: Extra_Ores
description: This Minecraft mod adds new minerals into different dimensions!
body:
**This is a Minecraft mod that adds a new ore, Beritium.**

![Beritium ores](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/326ca40abc05f127cef8334c24895f2417160a50.png)
Raw Beritium and Beritium Ingot.

It can **only** be found between "y" 4 and 5 on the nether.

![Beritium formation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0af108b68ac1692e7f5dbe813ffd5b42714ec06f.png)

It's a _better than Netherite_, tools dealing a lot of damage and the armor being super useful against mobs. It can even resist a full creeper explosion without any enchantments!

![Beritium tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9469ca5960e21bb7bdb38f29254682f465e08c90.png)

![Beritium armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9736c9253d9be56fa7d43924af40e01974d2aaf.png)

In the near future, I'll add more ores, this is just a really early version.
